notes: Caching is automatic (prefix-based). Invalidated by model changes; tool definition, schema or ORDERING changes; and parameter flips (reasoning.effort, text.verbosity, text.format). prompt_cache_key influences routing so matching prefixes land on the machine holding the cache. Usage fields are nested: input_tokens_details.cached_tokens sits INSIDE the input total, and there is no separately billed cache-write count in usage (cache writes bill at 1.25x within input).

gpt-5.5.ttl_notes: typically 5-10 min of inactivity, up to 1h; a 24h retention option exists; exact windows not published
